clue.text: Game requiring some tops

parts.note: some of a thing is a part of it
ridges are the tops of hills or roofs

explanation.surface: A game that calls for a few spinning tops.
explanation.definitionFit: These game birds are shot in season, and game means wild birds hunted for sport.

clue.text: Left harbour

explanation.surface: Someone departed from a harbour.
explanation.definitionFit: On a ship the left-hand side is called port; a port is also a town with a harbour for shipping.

clue.text: He tells of soldiers in opposition

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, a British army corps
counter means opposed, as in running counter to

explanation.surface: A man narrates the deeds of soldiers on the opposing side.
explanation.definitionFit: To recount is to narrate, so one who narrates a story is so called.

clue.text: Given the right aid possibly one or more than one spoke

indicators.note: possibly suggests the letters of aid could be arranged another way

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Someone wonders whether one or several spokes would help a wheel.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition's 'one' is the second one in the clue; the first is the Roman numeral piece, and 'possibly' signals the anagram.
explanation.definitionFit: The radial rods of a wheel are spokes, and the plural of radius names several such rods.

clue.text: Break up girl's gang

parts.note: Di is a short girl's name, so the possessive gives DIS
a band is a gang or group of people

explanation.surface: A command to split up some young woman's gang.
explanation.definitionFit: To disband a group is to dissolve it so its members go their own ways.

clue.text: Choosy man expected to make his mark

definitions.text: Choosy man expected to make his mark

parts.words: Choosy man expected to make his mark
parts.note: the person who picks a candidate is expected to put a cross on a ballot paper

explanation.surface: A fussy fellow is tipped to achieve something notable.
explanation.walkthrough: 'make his mark' sounds like success, but it is the voter's cross on the ballot paper.
explanation.definitionFit: A voter chooses between candidates and records the choice with a cross on the ballot.

clue.text: A little space reserved for a maple tree

indicators.note: A little says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A small spot has been kept back for planting a maple.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft put 'for' in the definition; it is a link word joining wordplay to 'maple tree'.
explanation.definitionFit: Acer is the botanical genus name of the maples, used as a common garden name.

clue.text: Many are inclined to wash

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, so it stands for many
to lean is to be inclined or tilted

explanation.surface: Lots of people feel disposed to have a wash.
explanation.definitionFit: To wash something is to remove dirt from it, which is the verb sense here.

clue.text: Consider getting in a rebel organisation that's worth saving

indicators.note: getting in tells us one piece enters inside the other
organisation suggests the letters of a rebel are put into a new order

parts.note: to deem is to consider or judge

explanation.surface: Think about joining a rebel group that deserves to be rescued.
explanation.walkthrough: 'organisation' signals the anagram and 'getting in' the insertion; 'Consider' looks like an instruction to the solver but is a synonym piece.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that can be bought back or rescued is fit for saving, as a sinner or a pawned item.

clue.text: The thespians' assistant must be quicker

explanation.surface: The actors' helper has to work faster.
explanation.definitionFit: A theatre helper feeds forgotten lines to actors; more prompt also means faster or more punctual.

clue.text: Bill, being in debt, gets hustled

indicators.note: being here means sitting within, so one piece is placed inside the other

parts.note: in the red means in debt, giving RED
AC is the abbreviation for account, a bill

explanation.surface: A man called Bill owes money and finds himself pushed around.
explanation.definitionFit: To be hustled is to be hurried along, the same as being rushed.

clue.text: Peers had a problem aggressive leaders

indicators.note: a problem with the letters means they are jumbled into a new order

explanation.surface: Members of the House of Lords had trouble with belligerent chiefs.
explanation.definitionFit: The front of an attack is the leading force, those who head an aggressive push.

clue.text: Thinking to put spirit into a worker

parts.note: rum is a spirit made from sugar cane
into gives the short word in
an ant is the classic worker insect

explanation.surface: An idea to give a labourer some liquor.
explanation.definitionFit: Cud-chewing animals give us a word for being meditative or contemplative.

clue.text: The guy say backing a beastly complaint

parts.note: a guy is a man

indicators.note: backing means the abbreviation for say is written backwards

parts.note: EG, for example, means say

explanation.surface: The fellow apparently supports an animal disease.
explanation.definitionFit: This skin disease caused by mites afflicts animals, so it is a complaint of beasts.

clue.text: A Parisian university man getting cut is irrational

parts.note: un is French for a
a BA is a graduate, Bachelor of Arts
lanced means cut open, as a boil

explanation.surface: A French graduate who has been cut is not thinking straight.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone mentally unstable is behaving without reason.

clue.text: Observed a thaw?

explanation.surface: Someone saw a thaw happen.
explanation.walkthrough: The second definition reads as two words: a thaw means something is not iced.
explanation.definitionFit: To notice is to observe or spot; when things thaw they are no longer frozen over.

clue.text: Writer of thrillers about a dog-trainer

parts.note: C, for circa, means about
a handler trains and controls dogs

explanation.surface: A crime novelist writes a book about a man who trains dogs.
explanation.walkthrough: Raymond Chandler wrote hard-boiled detective novels such as The Big Sleep.
explanation.definitionFit: Raymond Chandler was an American author of detective thrillers.

clue.text: Decline German and British article for building

parts.note: rot is decay or decline
und is German for and
a is the indefinite article in English

explanation.surface: Decay, a German word for and, and a British article combine.
explanation.definitionFit: A round building, usually domed, is the architectural sense meant.

clue.text: Taking a turn making a friend of course

indicators.note: taking the letters for a spin tells us they are rearranged

parts.note: an ally is a friend

explanation.surface: Taking a stroll creates a friendship, as you would expect.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Taking' rearranges A TURN to NATUR, followed by ALLY.
explanation.definitionFit: Saying something happens as a matter of course means it happens as expected.

clue.text: New bats are placed side by side

indicators.note: new suggests the letters are made into a fresh word

explanation.surface: New cricket bats are laid out next to each other.
explanation.definitionFit: Walking abreast means walking level with one another in a line.

clue.text: Gather outside-note the small bill for a snack

indicators.note: outside says one piece goes round the others

parts.note: to take in is to gather
E is a musical note
AC is the short form of account, a bill

explanation.surface: Collect outside, note the little bill for a bite to eat.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface reads 'outside' as a place, but it tells you the word for gather wraps around the note and the bill.
explanation.definitionFit: A toasted bun with currants is a typical light bite at teatime.

clue.text: To detract from personal appeal a number married

parts.note: to mar is to spoil or detract from
it is a dated word for sex appeal
L is the Roman numeral fifty

explanation.surface: A married person's charm is spoiled by numbers.
explanation.definitionFit: This adjective describes what relates to being wed.

clue.text: Terrible Osmanli curse

indicators.note: terrible suggests the letters are mangled into a new order

explanation.surface: A dreadful Ottoman Turk utters a curse.
explanation.walkthrough: Osmanli is an old word for an Ottoman Turk.
explanation.definitionFit: This is an archaic word for a malediction, the opposite of a blessing.

clue.text: A supporter receiving little credit appears bitter

indicators.note: receiving means the first piece takes the second inside it

parts.note: an aid is a supporter or helper
CR is the short form of credit

explanation.surface: Someone backing a cause gets scant thanks and seems resentful.
explanation.walkthrough: 'A supporter' is AID as one piece, not A plus a word.
explanation.definitionFit: A sharp, pungent taste or smell is described as harsh or bitter.

clue.text: Call for some rigorous economising

indicators.note: some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A demand for strict cost-cutting.
explanation.definitionFit: To call someone in the morning is to wake them.

clue.text: Fable making each and every point sanguinary

parts.note: all means each and every one
E, for east, is a compass point
sanguinary means bloody, which is gory

explanation.surface: A fable that makes every point bloodthirsty.
explanation.definitionFit: A fable is a story with a hidden moral meaning, a symbolic tale.

clue.text: Choose to travel with pro

parts.note: to go is to travel
pro means for, in favour of

explanation.surface: Decide to journey with a professional.
explanation.definitionFit: To opt for something is to pick it, the phrasal-verb sense here.

clue.text: Fit properly

explanation.surface: Something fits correctly.
explanation.definitionFit: Healthy is a sense of fit; done in the right manner is a sense of properly.

clue.text: Reason method's essential in paths over wetland

parts.note: a cause is a reason
a way is a method, and the possessive gives the S

explanation.surface: Logic and method are key in crossing marshland.
explanation.definitionFit: A raised road across marshy ground or water is a common type of embanked path.

clue.text: Invalid-a self-made invalid

indicators.note: made invalid suggests the letters are broken up into another order

explanation.surface: A patient who has recovered on their own is now unwell.
explanation.walkthrough: 'made invalid' rearranges A SELF; the first 'Invalid' (accent on the second syllable) is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: An invalid argument is untrue or wrong.

clue.text: River power at sea?

parts.note: the Dee is a river in Wales, England and Scotland
P is the symbol for power

explanation.surface: A river's strength when out on the ocean.
explanation.definitionFit: The deep is a poetic name for the ocean.

clue.text: Mint queen's coin

explanation.surface: Freshly made, a coin of the monarch.
explanation.walkthrough: Read as two words, a queen's coin is a penny that is royal.
explanation.definitionFit: This herb is a species of mint; split in two it names a regal copper coin.
